description.value:
You douse a 10-foot square within range in slick oil, which becomes difficult terrain for the duration. Any creature standing in the area when the oil appears must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone, and a creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must make the same save.

The oil is flammable: any 5-foot section exposed to fire burns away within a round. A creature that enters the burning oil or starts its turn there must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The flames can spread to catch nearby unattended flammable objects alight.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
